name: Plain Puree of Green Peas
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: paprica or a dash of cayenne
ingredients.originalText: paprica or a dash of cayenne

instructions.text: Boil and rub a quart of peas through a colander, or pass them through a vegetable-press.
Heat a tablespoonful of butter in a saucepan with pepper, paprica, or a dash of cayenne, half a teaspoonful of sugar, and three mint leaves, finely minced.
Stir in the pulped peas and toss and stir with a silver fork until they are very hot.
Pile upon a hot platter and lay triangles of fried bread about the base.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil and rub a quart of peas through a colander, or pass them through a vegetable-press.
2. Heat a tablespoonful of butter in a saucepan with pepper, paprica, or a dash of cayenne, half a teaspoonful of sugar, and three mint leaves, finely minced.
3. Stir in the pulped peas and toss and stir with a silver fork until they are very hot.
4. Pile upon a hot platter and lay triangles of fried bread about the base.
